categories.main_business_segments: Central China Securities Co., Ltd. operates primarily in securities brokerage, proprietary trading, investment banking, credit business, investment management, futures business, overseas business, and headquarters and other business segments. The company provides services including securities brokerage, investment advisory, underwriting and sponsorship, asset management, margin financing and securities lending, futures brokerage and consulting, and overseas capital market services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced financial technologies including digital platforms such as the Caishengbao APP for intelligent and digital service delivery. It uses expected credit loss models for impairment assessment, multi-index risk monitoring systems, mark-to-market valuation, and fintech applications including big data and AI to enhance compliance, risk management, and operational efficiency. The company also invests in blockchain pilot projects and digital transformation initiatives to improve service and operational capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base including institutional clients, mid-to-high-end private banking clients, retail investors, high-net-worth individuals, listed companies, pre-IPO firms, private enterprises, and regional enterprises primarily located in mainland China, especially Henan Province. It also serves clients in Hong Kong and overseas markets through its subsidiaries. Major customers span various industries, with no single customer accounting for more than 30% of operating revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: Central China Securities has a strong presence in Henan Province with the most comprehensive securities branch network in the province, including 30 branch offices and 74 securities branches across 9 provinces and municipalities in China. It also operates in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, and overseas through its Hong Kong subsidiary, Central China International, providing cross-border capital market services.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream financial services provider in the capital market supply chain, acting as an intermediary between capital providers and users. It functions as a securities broker, investment bank, asset manager, and proprietary trader, facilitating capital raising, investment advisory, trading, and financing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on becoming a first-class modern investment bank with leading regional market position, emphasizing professionalism, integration, platform building, and base strengthening. It prioritizes digital transformation, fintech integration, compliance and risk management enhancement, and development of specialized investment research teams. The company also aims to deepen its role as a strategic carrier in Henan’s capital market, expanding wealth management, investment banking, and asset management capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through commissions and fees from securities brokerage, underwriting and sponsorship fees from investment banking, interest income from credit business (margin financing and securities lending), management fees from asset and private fund management, trading gains and investment income from proprietary trading, and service fees from futures brokerage and overseas business operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Central China Securities positions itself as a leading regional securities firm in Henan Province with a comprehensive branch network and integrated financial services. It ranks 46th in equity underwriting revenue and 49th in underwriting amount nationally, and holds a strong market share in the New Third Board in Henan. The company leverages its dual A+H share listings and cross-border capabilities to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of end 2024, the company reported total assets of RMB 51.6 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 246 million, showing a 16.18% increase year-on-year in net profit despite a 14.13% decrease in operating income. It has a registered capital of RMB 4.64 billion and a stable equity base. The company’s net capital and risk control indicators meet regulatory requirements, and it has demonstrated steady growth in brokerage and investment management businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Central China Securities emphasizes its role as a strategic carrier in Henan’s capital market, offering integrated financial services through its 'N-nity' service matrix that synergizes investment banking, wealth management, asset management, and proprietary trading. It differentiates itself through a comprehensive branch network, strong regional market penetration, digital transformation initiatives, and a client-centric approach focusing on customized asset allocation and professional advisory services. The company also leverages its dual listing and cross-border platforms to provide unique Mainland-Hong Kong capital market solutions.
